_about: Version lineage for the public demo: every copy that is not live greets visitors once and links to the newer and earlier versions. Same idea as my-template/walkthroughs/VERSION-LINEAGE.md. Oldest first. Paths are relative to the demo root. A new stop is added only when an overhaul lands, so the journey stays readable.

stops.label: v1 · the DApp University build
stops.note: The dashboard as Christopher first built it on the DApp University framework: one pool per DEX, prices every poll, the trade terminal and the activity monitor. Frozen on 25 Oct 2026.

stops.label: v2 · the edge terminal
stops.note: Everything built since: every fee tier priced as its own venue in one block, routes ranked after pool fees, the seven-day edge study, the journal, phone alerts, and this terminal that explains itself. The live copy; the next line gets drawn at the next overhaul.
